notes.title: MGZ: Nursery Update!
notes.notes:
There is a new area in the star base laboratory, it was designed for you to hatch and raise your stars. It includes a new mini game, new setting, new NPC's and with a new set of actions that brings along a brand new difficulty.

Instead of playing the old hand guessing game, now there is Baby Game. Each time you need to replenish your Baby Star's mood you can play a dot connecting game, the trick is to connect all the dots and also fill in the board completely. Its a fun logic puzzle, and each time you play there is a randomly generated board. 

Features are similar from the ones we had before, but now you must educate, feed and look after you pet carefully or they can flee the lab. We are removing the death of stars, and instead replaced it with losing pets into space. Hatching new stars will cost extra in game Zoot.

Baby Stars aren't fully aware of themselves, that's why Stardust's OWO Operating System will come in handy to assist every single step of the way letting you know what your pet needs. Stars now read books and collect allowance as they grow. We are also including a new mini-game available with the nursery.

We are testing interactive background design which includes a new robot in the Matchyverse! Introducing Red, he will be helping along bringing cuteness into the game. It's still under construction but it is available now for you to play and provide feedback as we build it.

notes.title: Big Zoot Update!
notes.notes:
We've spent a lot of time working out the economy for the food upgrades in Matchymart and now there is no limit to the amount of Zoot you can collect.


Fix bugs on older machines.
Add interactive elements to splash screen.
You can interact with, throw and move, coins in Xanadu and the splash screen.
Zoot is rendered as big numbers with suffixes for very high values.
Food can be upgraded in Matchymart.
You can build special ships that are worth tons of Zoot.
Special ships value can be upgraded.
Salad takes longer to digest than other food and is up-gradable.
Corndog gives you a chance to build a big ship worth more.
Eating a snack transforms you into that snack.
Snacks help you train your pet by forcing them to do personality actions.
There is a thought gear between personality actions to help you train your Star.
You can collect Xanadu Coins for earning tons of Zoot.
Add polish to text elements, shadows and layering are correct.
Tweak sugar rush cap value.
The care level you give Stars affects even high level Stars.
Clicking Zee's nametag and glasses has better effects.
Clean up sprite hit boxes.
Cash SFX only occurs on big purchases.
Back button is consistent: always upper right.


Phew! That's a lot of fixes, upgrades, and polish. I recommend you do a hard reset in the settings menu and try to earn the new upgrades in the order they are given out, but its not required.

We'd love to hear your feedback on the new build, and we'll fix anything that is broken so hit us up in https://discord.silverwaregames.com our Discord server to let us know if you have any feedback. Our social links are listed below too!

-Michael, Big Cheesy Potato.
